question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**however**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about "calcium supplements."
 
• Now, **the word to be mentioned in blank 4 will introduce a contrast in the sentence.**
 
• **Thus, among the given options the most appropriate and logically correct word to use in blank 4 is "however."** 
 
 
• 'However' is an adverb that means 'nevertheless' or 'in spite of that'.(मगर)
 
 
 
• It is used to introduce a contrasting statement or idea.
 
 
• Example: I thought the movie would be boring. However, it turned out to be really entertaining.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

• Option 1, 'whoever', is a pronoun used to refer to any person who is not known or specified.(कोई भी हो)
 
• Option 2, 'whatever', is a pronoun used to refer to anything that is not known or specified.(जो कुछ भी)
 
• Option 3, 'ever', is an adverb used to emphasize a quality or characteristic.(कभी)
